## Scope

Describe the user-facing change and identify whether this is a checkpoint release, targeted fix, or documentation-only change.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] Full Vitest suite passes.
- [ ] TypeScript passes.
- [ ] Production dependency audit passes.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] Required responsive or browser checks pass.
- [ ] GitHub Quality Gate passes.
- [ ] API Recovery Browser Check passes.
- [ ] Security findings are resolved or documented as reviewed false positives.

## Release integrity

- [ ] This branch preserves GitHub and managed-project history.
- [ ] This branch does not force-push or overwrite unrelated work.
- [ ] The proposed file tree exactly matches the validated managed checkpoint.
- [ ] Production propagation has been checked where applicable.
- [ ] After merge, remote `main` will be compared with the managed release tree.
